Subject: Apex Logistics — Supplier onboarding & vendor master info needed

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — excited to get Apex set up so our PM/ops teams can start routing freight. To get your vendor record created in our system we need a few items from you so Finance can issue POs and wire payments:

- Legal business name (exact as registered)
- Entity type (LLC / Corporation / Branch) and country of registration
- Tax ID / EIN (we can accept last 4 digits if you prefer and then collect full docs via secure link)
- Remit address and physical address (if different)
- Primary billing contact (name, title, email, phone)
- Bank details for ACH/wire (bank name, account number, routing/IBAN — please send via secure attachment)
- W-9 (for US entities) or equivalent VAT certificate for EU entities
- Any DUNS or vendor codes you use

I've attached our standard Redwood_Supplier_Onboarding_Form.pdf — you can fill that out and return it, or paste the details into a reply. For bank details, please attach a bank letter or scanned voided check (we cannot accept bank details in clear email unless it is a secure attachment).

A few process notes:
- Our standard payment terms are Net30 unless Finance agrees otherwise.
- We generate a PO after the vendor is created; please confirm the exact remit address you expect to appear on the PO.
- Once Finance confirms vendor creation I'll share the Redwood vendor code so you can reference it on invoices.

If you can return the completed form and the W-9/bank auth by end of day Thursday (2027-04-22), we should be able to issue the first PO for the upcoming SOW.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
